_readme: Ships EMPTY on purpose. Holiday dates were not invented: a wrong date here
rejects a real trading session and loses that day's history permanently,
which is worse than the stale-row bug this file exists to help close.
The weekend gate in utils/market_calendar.py needs no data and is already
complete — it closes the case actually observed (2026-08-22, a Saturday).
This file adds holiday coverage on top of that.
To populate: copy the trading-holiday dates from the NSE/BSE annual circular
into 'holidays', add the year to 'coverage_years', and record the source.
Dates outside coverage_years fall back to weekend-only, reported as
'trading_unverified' rather than silently claimed as a trading day.
